palette.rule: Semantic colours only; income/expense/transfer remain distinguishable and labelled.

brand.rule: Approved light/dark mark only. Preserve identity, aspect ratio, dimensions and accessible name.

header.rule: Paint only; preserve header height, controls and navigation order.

navigation.rule: Preserve routes, labels, order, hit targets and selected/focus states.

hero.rule: Never alter amounts, formatting, text colour meaning or figure position.

cards.rule: Keep padding, shape, border width, row heights, reading order and content.

charts.rule: Preserve financial series meaning, axes, labels and non-colour distinctions.

controls.rule: Keep dimensions, keyboard behaviour, validation and disabled/error states.

overlays.rule: Keep stacking, modal focus containment, dismiss behaviour and screen-reader labels.

menus.rule: Keep menu contents, order, keyboard access and hit targets.

decoration.rule: Approved inert patterns and motions only, drawn by theme-decor.css. Never obscure content or touch numbers. Reduced motion disables all decoration motion.
